title: 启用困难样本挖掘 (Hard Negative Mining)

standard.summary: 只回传 loss 最高的 top-k% 样本梯度
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Backpropagates gradients only from the top-k% samples by loss
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 只回传 loss 最高的 top-k% 样本梯度，聚焦困难样本训练。类似 Focal Loss 思想。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Backpropagates gradients only for the top-k% highest-loss samples, focusing training on hard examples — similar in spirit to Focal Loss. Off by default.
